name: Conformance: Prompt-Library All Four Kinds End-to-End
description: RFC 0027 §A end-to-end coverage of all four `PromptKind` values (system, user, schema-hint, few-shot). Single mock-ai node configured with one ref per kind; when the node executes, the host MUST resolve each ref via the four-layer chain (RFC 0029 §A), emit one `agent.promptResolved` event per kind, compose the body (RFC 0027 §E), emit one `prompt.composed` event per composition, and complete the run successfully. Few-shot is exercised as a single-entry list to keep the assertion count tractable. Capability-gated: host MUST advertise `capabilities.prompts.supported: true`. See conformance/src/scenarios/prompt-all-four-kinds-events.test.ts.

variables.name: prompt
variables.description: Optional inline prompt content. The mock-ai node prefers the composed bodies (concatenated in system → schema-hint → few-shot → user order) when refs are present; this variable is the fallback baseline if no ref resolves.
